dog.description_text: Meet Sherlock! He is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Sherlock is a seven-year-old male described as social and easygoing. His favorite pastimes include watching birds from the window and curling up in a warm lap for a nice, long snooze. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQBRqpyoWmBoQ6S2K3_Ez6lRASb0V3XRBbdZNoFzs4p9koc?e=ZoYZ8L Sherlock is a lap cat and very affectionate. His foster says "Sherlock has grown to be so much more affectionate the longer he's with us. He is so calm and sweet and he is the best to have around. His little trills and chirps when we wake up or come back home always make my day.He keeps on getting better and better. So sweet. Old man vibes mixed with wanting to sit directly on top of you. Sherlock is not shy at all and is extremely loving. From the second I brought him home he wants to be around every person who walks in. He will follow you around like your shadow. Will greet you when you come through the door. He’s very clumsy and will have a conversation with you. As time has gone on he’s become significantly more affectionate (wanting to sit on you.) He is so quiet, gentle, sweet. He warms up immediately and is good at setting boundaries, never biting or scratching.". He may be happiest in a home without other pets. He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved. 09/12/2026 | Foster Notes
